by
  have appendSubset :
      ∀ {a b c d : List Expression.Ident},
        a.Subset (c ++ [h1]) →
        b.Subset (d ++ [h1]) →
        (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d ++ [h1]) := by
    intro a b c d hac hbd x hx
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · have hy : x ∈ c ∨ x = h1 := by
        simpa only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] using hac hx
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hy)
      · exact Or.inr hy
    · have hy : x ∈ d ∨ x = h1 := by
        simpa only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] using hbd hx
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hy)
      · exact Or.inr hy
  induction post with
  | const c =>
      simp [List.Subset, substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | op o ty =>
      simp [List.Subset, substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | bvar b =>
      simp [List.Subset, substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | fvar md name ty =>
      simp [List.Subset, substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | abs md ty e ih =>
      simpa [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using ih
  | quant md k ty tr e trih eih =>
      simpa [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_assoc] using
        appendSubset trih eih
  | app md fn e fnih eih =>
      simp only [substOld]
      split
      · split <;>
          simp_all [List.Subset, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
            Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      · simpa [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_assoc] using
          appendSubset fnih eih
  | ite md c t e cih tih eih =>
      simpa [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_assoc] using
        appendSubset (appendSubset cih tih) eih
  | eq md e₁ e₂ e₁ih e₂ih =>
      simpa [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_assoc] using
        appendSubset e₁ih e₂ih

diagnosis: `hac hx` and `hbd hx` produce inductive `List.Mem` proofs, so destructuring them directly as disjunctions causes dependent-elimination failures. Materializing each result with an explicit disjunctive type lets `simp` normalize membership before `rcases`; the remaining structural proof is unchanged.
